title: Relative associated points persist generically along their closures for finite-type morphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: One must turn a fibrewise associated prime into a globally embedded cyclic module after generic flatness. A second generic-flatness step makes the cokernel flat so that the injection survives every fibre, allowing all generic points of the resulting fibre supports to be recognized as associated points.
